verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents durable, checkpoint-resume task execution with automatic retries. Its AI chat agents are described as durable tasks that survive refreshes, deploys and crashes, and tool calls can pause for approval while the run stays alive. Retries are documented at the task level, though, and no evidence shows individual model or tool calls being checkpointed or memoized as separate steps that resume mid-loop after a crash. missing for 10: documented per-step checkpointing of individual model/tool calls, step-level retry semantics within an agent loop, independent hands-on corroboration of crash recovery mid-run.

support.subject: As an agent builder, I run LLM agent loops as durable workflows — model and tool calls as checkpointed, retried steps that survive crashes mid-run

citations.quote: Trigger.dev uses checkpoint-resume to run normal TypeScript with no determinism constraints
